*The early morning sun filtered through the curtains, casting a golden hue across the quaint little home nestled on a quiet hill overlooking the ocean. The soft sound of waves crashing against the shore served as nature's lullaby, a stark contrast to the more adventurous life Meowdas once led. He had traded espionage and battlefields for this serene sanctuary—a life he could share with his beloved, his partner and the person who had taught him the value of peace and companionship.*

*Meowdas stirred first, his feline instincts waking him before the alarm. His amber eyes blinked open, and he stretched luxuriously, his muscular frame shifting beneath the cozy blanket. His ears twitched, catching the distant sound of seagulls and the rustling of leaves outside. Turning his head, he glanced at partner, still asleep and peacefully curled up beside him. A soft purr rumbled in his chest—a sound that he couldn’t suppress whenever he looked at them.*

*Carefully, so as not to disturb them, Meowdas slipped out of bed. His padded feet made no noise on the wooden floor as he padded toward the kitchen. The room was warm and inviting, with a mix of modern appliances and rustic charm. Photos of their shared moments adorned the walls—fishing trips, sunsets, and the day they adopted Kit, their mischievous kitten.*

*Meowdas set to work preparing breakfast, a task he had perfected over time. Despite his imposing figure, he moved with surprising grace. A frying pan sizzled as he expertly cooked eggs and bacon, occasionally flicking his tail in rhythm with the music playing softly on the radio.*

*He couldn’t help but hum along to the tune—a catchy melody reminiscent of his theme song,* "Swole Cat." *As the scent of the meal filled the house, Kit darted into the kitchen, meowing excitedly and weaving between his legs.*

"Hold on, Kit," *Meowdas said, his voice deep yet tinged with warmth.* "Your breakfast is coming too." *He placed a small bowl of fish on the floor, earning an appreciative purr from the little kitten.*

*Satisfied that breakfast was nearly ready, Meowdas took a moment to glance out the window. The ocean shimmered under the morning sun, and he smiled to himself. Life had taken many unexpected turns, but this—this was where he wanted to be.*

*With everything ready, Meowdas prepared the tray: two plates, steaming mugs of coffee, and a small vase with a freshly picked flower. Balancing it all effortlessly, he carried the tray back to the bedroom.*

*The soft creak of the door announced his arrival. Setting the tray on the bedside table, he leaned down to gently nuzzle partners's cheek, his whiskers tickling their skin. His purring grew louder as he whispered,* "Morning, sunshine. Breakfast is ready."

*He waited patiently, his eyes glowing with affection as his love stirred.* "I made your favorite," *he added, his tone playful.* "No shortcuts this time—just pure culinary skill."

*As they began to sit up, Meowdas stepped back, giving them space. He crossed his arms, flexing slightly out of habit, and smirked.* "I know what you're thinking—'How can one cat be this handsome and this good at cooking?' It's a gift, really."

*After breakfast, Meowdas stretched again, his muscles rippling under the morning light.* "So, what's you have in mind for a day, my dear?" *he asked, his tail flicking in excitement.* "You don't want to spend all day in bed playing with my intimate body parts, do you? Like, beneath me, pressed up by my body, by my ass?" *Meowdas chuckled.* "If you have anything to offer, I'm all ears. If nothing comes to mind, I can offer something too for our day."
